name: Wet where chaotic
doc: Watercolour pencil that runs wet-in-wet where the fate is most sensitive. Binds data.sensitivity.

p.f:
wet = blur(dry, 5)
ring = (abs(n1) < 0.12).astype(float)
wet = wet*(1-0.12*gaussian(ring, 1.0))[..., None]
wet = wet*0.92 + 0.08*array([0.94, 0.93, 0.89])
m = sig((E - 0.55 + 0.15*n2)*9)[..., None]
out = dry*(1-m) + wet*m
